purpose: clause fixtures whose verdict is COMPUTED, not narrated: scripts/validate_spatial_loop_grounded.py judges each directory from its own bytes and reds when the verdict it computes disagrees with the expectation declared here.
why_mechanical: a clause whose only evidence is its own prose has never been evaluated. The behavioral campaigns judge actor runs with a live model and are deliberately outside hermetic run_all; these fixtures are the hermetic half - they judge the CLAUSE against artifacts the clause is about, so an amendment that reads well and decides nothing fails closed.
both_directions: every judged clause must carry at least one compliant and one violating fixture. A judge that has only ever agreed is a single arrival: nothing shows it can refuse.
